//: A second configuration rather than a shared one, because the two halves of
this repository compile under genuinely different assumptions: the server
targets NodeNext with no DOM, and the browser targets a bundler with no Node.
Merging them would hand server code a `document` it must never touch, and
browser code a `process.env` it cannot read. `npm run typecheck` runs both.
The strictness flags are copied from the root config on purpose — a relaxed
frontend is how `undefined` reaches a chart axis.
